subject.title: The Most Tragic Fossils Ever Discovered

required_sequence.receipt: The official page identified the video and exposed its main image as https://i.ytimg.com/vi_webp/NF42pH3oXZw/maxresdefault.webp; the page image field exposed the required JPG URL below.

required_sequence.action: fetch the same video ID's actual official JPG
required_sequence.error: functions.fetch_page returned HTTP 500; no JPG bytes were returned.
Direct official variants returned HTTP 500. A UAPI response for the exact default.jpg source decoded to a malformed JPEG with no usable pixel frame: ImageMagick reported 0x0 and SOS before SOF.

required_sequence.action: retrieve the exact same-ID official JPG through a source-preserving relay
required_sequence.relay_method: UAPI /api/v1/image/tobase64, followed by local base64 decode
required_sequence.jpeg_validation: ImageMagick identified a valid 120x90 JPEG with 10,800 pixels; no repair or pixel editing was applied.
required_sequence.provenance_limit: The relay fetched the exact official source URL but re-encoded the response. This local file is not claimed to be byte-identical to i.ytimg.com.

required_sequence.receipt: read_file opened the local 120x90 relay-derived JPG. A nearest-neighbour enlargement was used only as a temporary inspection aid; it is not evidence or a deliverable.

visual_notes.basis: read_file on the valid same-ID relay-derived JPG; notes are not promoted to byte-identical official-thumbnail claims
observations: The upper-left contains two lines of large white all-capital text reading ULTIMATE / SUFFERING.
The frame is a wide landscape composition with a muted blue-gray sky, a green-yellow middle ground, and a blue-gray water-like strip along the bottom.
Brown and tan long-legged quadruped-like animal forms occupy the left and right sides; the right edge also contains a cropped foreground form.
Dark horizontal bands are visible above and below the image content.
At this 120x90 resolution, no clearly legible trilobite or fossil form is visible.
limitations: These are pixel-grounded observations of the exact video-ID source as decoded by the relay, not claims about the raw official JPG byte stream.
The thumbnail does not establish the selected film's scientific claims, source evidence, or audience response.

accepted_conclusions: The official watch page and exact video ID were verified.
A valid local, readable 120x90 image was recovered from a relay whose query names the exact official same-ID default.jpg endpoint.
Relay-scoped visual notes are recorded, with their re-encoding limitation stated.
The raw direct/UAPI official JPG bytes remain unverified or malformed; byte identity is not claimed.
Third-party reposts, search-result images, and competitor artwork remain excluded from the evidence and rights ledger.
No thumbnail-derived claim is locked, and no production or publication authorization follows from this receipt.
next_safe_action: Use the relay-scoped notes only for research context. Preserve the raw-byte limitation, then finish the evidence, typed-claims, rights, native-visual-proof, story, and feasibility review before any owner claim lock or production step.
